title: Red Rat in Ruins
description: A vibrant red rat with white underbelly and pink ears sits upright on a tree branch, looking toward the right. Behind it stretches a desolate, post-apocalyptic landscape with ruined buildings under a stormy, overcast sky.
prompt: A highly detailed red rat with white chest and pink inner ears perched on a mossy tree branch with yellowing leaves, looking to the side with dark eyes. In the background is a foggy, ruined cityscape with crumbling buildings and overgrown vegetation under a dark stormy sky, atmospheric perspective, cinematic lighting, moody color palette
